info.name: Once a new user is registered they must confirm their registration via an email

params.name: account_id
params.description: the uuid in the link of the confirmation email

items.docs: When a new account is registered, it must first be confirmed before full access is granted. An email will be sent to the email address used during registration. There will be a link in that email that points to https://server.com/register/{accountid}

info.name: This allows a user to unregister their account

items.docs: If the user wants to unregister their account from repo, this endpoint uses the currently logged in user to unregister. A confirmation email will be sent to the registered address before unregistration is complete.

info.name: This is confirm that the user does want to unregister their account from repo

items.docs: This endpoint will normally be called due to the user confirming their unregistration from the confirmation email they received

info.name: Update user token information

params.name: token_id
params.description: Id of the token position, not an X-Auth or JWT token itself!

params.name: reissue_token
params.description: update token endpoint by default reissues a new token.

items.docs: By default reissues a new token and returns in `token` attribute. If `reissue_token` query parameter is false, then token is not reissued and old value is used. The api returns `null` as a token in this case.
